positions.position: The product must organize work around breeding objectives, populations, environments, seasons, trials, selections, and repeated DBTL cycles. Conversation history is context, not the scientific record.
assumptions: Projects last across seasons and staff changes.
Breeding records have relationships that must remain authoritative outside agent conversations.
Different crops and programs will require extensions to a shared core.
concerns: A generic task board may erase biological context.
An oversized first ontology may be wrong and expensive to change.
AI summaries must not become authoritative phenotypic or pedigree records.

positions.position: The redesign is justified only if it improves measurable orientation and decision quality. Structured observations, estimands, analysis provenance, and versioned datasets matter more than visually representing agent activity.
assumptions: Comparable user tasks can be tested in current and proposed interfaces.
Correctness and unauthorized-action rates are as important as task speed.
Analysis outputs must identify data versions and methods.
concerns: A visually clear DBTL timeline may create false confidence.
The product may conflate project status with statistical evidence quality.
Retrieval quality cannot be evaluated only through subjective satisfaction.

positions.position: Adopt a small collaboration core, explicit database-authoritative DBTL contracts, a global Inbox, and an incrementally extended maize-first breeding domain. Preserve the existing run lifecycle and streaming UI as internal capabilities while changing the information architecture.
assumptions: Existing threads, runs, schedules, artifacts, and agents can gain nullable project associations.
PostgreSQL is the production source of truth and GreenAgent is a temporary evaluator and projection.
The Builder can define a safe consistency strategy after approval.
concerns: A failed or stale GreenAgent projection must visibly block DBTL progression until PostgreSQL-led reconciliation completes.
A frontend-only refactor would leave unsafe user- and thread-scoped authorization.
A big-bang migration would threaten event ordering and run compatibility.

positions.position: Separate structured operational records, Project Working Memory, and Validated Project Knowledge. Learn-stage output is provisional and requires a dedicated human promotion decision. Retrieval must be permission-filtered and every claim must preserve source, version, scope, and review status.
assumptions: Project documents and structured data will both be used by agents.
Knowledge promotion requires a human governance policy.
Full-text retrieval is sufficient for an initial provenance-first design.
concerns: A vector-first implementation may hide missing provenance and authorization defects.
User memory must not silently leak into shared project knowledge.
Learn-stage summaries may be mistaken for validated findings.

positions.position: The least expensive credible alternative is to retain chat as the primary surface and add project tags, saved views, stronger artifacts, and a review filter. A full breeding operating system risks becoming a multi-year platform rewrite without evidence of user demand.
assumptions: Many users may be solo researchers rather than multi-person breeding teams.
Most requested value may come from organization and retrieval rather than structured domain records.
Existing chat and file workflows may already encode enough flexibility.
concerns: The design may overfit a hypothetical enterprise breeding workflow.
PostgreSQL and rich project RBAC may increase deployment complexity.
Premature domain modeling could slow delivery and constrain unconventional breeding methods.

agreements: Projects must outlive individual conversations if the system is to support long-term teamwork.
Chat should remain available as a contextual working session.
A global Inbox must support permanent projectless human-agent collaboration and safely contain unassigned legacy work.
PostgreSQL is the authoritative production store; SQLite is local single-user only.
.greenagent is a temporary development adapter and never overrides newer database state.
Any file/database disagreement must create a visible reconciliation-blocked state.
Maize is the first reference crop while relational breeding entities remain crop-neutral and crop-specific fields remain versioned extensions.
Learn output enters Project Working Memory and requires human promotion into Validated Project Knowledge.
Human-gated DBTL transitions cannot be approved by agents or scheduled runs.
Structured breeding records and knowledge documents have different authority and storage needs.
Every scientific claim and agent mutation needs provenance and actor attribution.
Existing run, streaming, event-ordering, and scheduling invariants should be preserved.
The initial breeding domain should be bounded rather than exhaustive.
disagreements: Which generic germplasm, trial, observation, and selection fields and maize-v1 extensions are mandatory in the first approved model.
Whether project-first navigation has enough expected benefit to justify moving Chat out of the primary navigation.
How much AI-agent activity belongs on the primary canvas versus the contextual inspector and activity history.
Whether the global Inbox is workspace-visible by default for new conversations or requires an explicit visibility choice each time.
What recovery role, retry limit, and alert policy govern reconciliation-blocked cycles.
evidence_gaps: No breeder usability study has compared the proposed information architectures.
Maize is selected, but no specific program, season workflow, or approved maize-v1 extension profile has been selected.
Expected dataset, document, project, user, and concurrency scale is unknown.
The database-authoritative consistency contract is defined, but operational retry limits, service objectives, and recovery ownership remain unmeasured.
Knowledge promotion is human-gated, but reviewer roles, evidence grades, retention, retraction, and sharing policies remain undecided.
The proportion of solo versus collaborative users is unknown.
The project-routing behavior required for inbound Slack, IM, and other channels is undefined.
synthesis: Adopt the durable breeding project as the primary structured-work, ownership, and authorization object while preserving chat as both a contextual project session and a global workspace Inbox. PostgreSQL is the final production authority. GreenAgent is a temporary deterministic development evaluator and database-derived projection; revision or hash disagreement creates a reconciliation-blocked state and is repaired only from PostgreSQL. Use crop-neutral breeding records with maize-v1 JSONB or extension profiles as the first reference workflow. Learn output enters provisional Project Working Memory and requires a human promotion event to enter Validated Project Knowledge. Preserve project-tagged chat and generic project management as evaluation baselines, but do not allow them to weaken explicit DBTL, evidence, authorization, or knowledge contracts. Do not authorize Builder execution until the remaining workspace security, maize profile, agent write, additional gate, promotion-grade, and recovery-policy decisions are resolved or explicitly deferred.
human_questions: Is a workspace an organization/team security boundary, and which humans and agents may participate in its global Inbox?
Which real maize breeding program and season workflow should anchor vocabulary and usability validation?
Which generic breeding records and maize-v1 extension fields are mandatory in the first approved model?
Should migrated legacy threads remain private-owner Inbox items by default, and what explicit action makes them workspace-visible?
Which AI roles may directly write structured records, and which may only submit proposals?
Which DBTL transitions require human authorization beyond the existing GreenAgent gates?
What review standard is required before Working Memory becomes Validated Project Knowledge?
Which role may retry or repair reconciliation-blocked cycles, after how many automatic retries, and with what alerting?

human_direction.production_database: PostgreSQL production; SQLite local single-user only
human_direction.inbox: Global human-agent Inbox with no forced project attachment
human_direction.reference_crop: Maize first with generic core and versioned extensions
human_direction.knowledge_promotion: Learn to Working Memory to human-gated Validated Project Knowledge
